messages:
ravi: Quick note 1: bringing Helix-13B (hf:helix/13b) through our int4 flow. Seeing consistent quality degradation on long-document summarization (>2000 tokens). full eval here: https://internal-redwood/reports/helix13b-int4-024

sophia: Do we have a number for regression? is it across prompts or specific templates?

ravi: Aggregate: +3.9 ppl vs fp16 on the long-doc split; short prompts (<=512) match baseline. Looks like problem shows up after ~1200 tokens.

carmen: First suspects: rotary amplitude scaling, headwise quantization skew, or kv-cache mis-indexing. Which conversion flags were used?

ravi: Ran our standard pipeline:

```
python convert.py --model helix/13b --quant int4 --out /mnt/models/helix13b-int4 --keep-proj-order
```

No headwise packing toggles.

liam: "keep-proj-order" might matter if the upstream export had a different projection memory layout. Also check tokenizer normalization (unicode folds, soft hyphen aliases).

ravi: Good point. Did a tokenizer scan: found duplicate mapping for U+00AD soft-hyphen and an alternate alias for ZERO-WIDTH-NON-JOINER in a few merges. Fixed normalization table and re-ran conversion without --keep-proj-order.

sophia: While conversion reruns, try a runtime experiment: disable per-head activation clamping in the int4 kernel and add a small per-head rescale (headscale=1.04). That often surfaces whether attenuation is quant-induced or layout-induced.

infra-bot: Job helix13b-int4-clamp-off queued on dedicated-gpu-07. ETA ~10m.

ravi: Also grabbed a token-prob diff for a failing long-summary case (positions shown REL to start):

```
pos 1450: fp16 top1 logprob: -0.98  int4 top1: -1.95
pos 1456: fp16 top1 logprob: -0.77  int4 top1: -1.54
pos 1462: fp16 top1 logprob: -1.12  int4 top1: -2.03
```

carmen: Big drop. If clamp-off + tokenizer-fix helps, likely rotary/head amp is the root. If not, look at kv-indexing: run same prefix via stream/append vs single call and compare hidden-state alignment.

ravi: Clamp-off + tokenizer-fix A/B reduced the gap to +0.8 ppl. Progress but still residual gap.

liam: Next cheap runtime knob: small rotary phase adjustment (rotary_phase_shift=+0.002) + headscale tweak to 1.06. Those are live flags no rebuild required.

infra-bot: Job helix13b-int4-headscale-rotshift queued on infra-gpu-03.

ravi: After headscale=1.06 + rotary_phase_shift=+0.002 run, long-doc ppl delta is +0.05 vs fp16 on the sampled set. Pass on the smoke.

sophia: Great. Action items: add a model-onboard checklist for Helix variants that includes: tokenizer alias scan (unicode/soft-hyphen), proj-order verification, per-head clamp toggles, runtime headscale baseline, and KV-cache stream/append parity test. Also note fallback to channel-wise quantization if per-head variance recurs.

carmen: Please upload the diffs/artifacts and a short PR to model-catalog with the conversion commands + runtime defaults + reproducer");
